review.use_summary: Used FUMA SNP2GENE/MAGMA to define previously known gene-trait associations alongside bulk DLPFC S-TWAS. The known set is their union after FDR correction across traits. Set gene type to all, custom MHC coordinates 28477797–33448354 and symmetric 50 kb windows after GRCh37 liftover.
review.implementation_scope_note: The FUMA release is unstated. MungeSumstats preparation/liftover and subsequent two-sided Fisher enrichment with Bonferroni correction are separate stages; the MAGMA citation number is not a software version.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.3.8 to define risk loci with LD thresholds 0.6 and 0.1 and a 250 kb merge distance, then annotate variants with ANNOVAR and run MAGMA gene, gene-set and gene-property analyses. Used MSigDB 7.0 with 16992 terms, GTEx 8 and single-cell expression, BH-FDR below 0.05, conditional reanalysis and default GENE2FUNC follow-up.
review.implementation_scope_note: The clumping reference is 1000 Genomes ALL ancestries; the ancestry-proportioned custom reference belongs to MAGMA. DropViz mouse and human ventral midbrain expression remain distinct data sources. Do not apply either reference universally or infer unenumerated GENE2FUNC defaults.

supporting_evidence.section: Gene set analysis finds enrichment in brain tissues

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.6.1 for GWAS-DCM and MTAG-DCM locus analysis with lead P < 5e-8, r-squared < 0.05, a 1000 Genomes Phase 3 European reference and 1 Mb locus merging; used its MAGMA 1.08/GTEx 8 and ANNOVAR annotation. GENE2FUNC tested 63 prioritized genes against Ensembl 102 protein-coding background with at least two overlaps and two-stage BKY adjusted one-sided P < 0.05.
review.implementation_scope_note: The coding-variant follow-up uses r-squared > 0.65. Open Targets 22.10 nearest-gene prioritization is separate. The software list also reports standalone MAGMA 1.10; that must not replace MAGMA 1.08 in the FUMA workflow. The availability list corroborates versions rather than independently proving execution.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / Locus definitions, variant annotation and gene prioritization / Protein-altering variation and closest protein-coding gene

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.3.8/MAGMA 1.08 with a 1000 Genomes East Asian LD reference, 19033 Ensembl 92 protein-coding genes and 15485 MSigDB 7.0 gene sets. Compared annotation-window choices and tested GTEx 8 gene-property enrichment across 54 tissues and 30 general tissue types at FDR < 5%.
review.implementation_scope_note: The Ensembl reference citation number is not an alternate annotation release. The primary paragraph does not enumerate the compared window sizes. Tissue gene-property tests differ from gene-list overrepresentation.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / Tissue- and cell-type specificity analysis

review.use_summary: Ran FUMA 1.6.1/MAGMA 1.08 for each meta-analysis stratum after VEP 112 rsID assignment and Picard LiftOverVcf 3.1.1 conversion to GRCh37. Compared 0 kb gene windows against 35 kb upstream/10 kb downstream windows, and declared pathways at q < 0.05 in either analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The source describes the BH-FDR denominator using the gene count. Retain this ambiguity and the two-window declaration rule rather than substituting a pathway-family or across-window correction. No-rsID and failed-liftover variants are removed before FUMA.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.6.1 with reported default parameters to identify independent loci, calling a locus novel if no previously reported variant lay within 250 kb of its lead variant.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph does not enumerate the FUMA defaults. Liftover, allele harmonization, MAF/imputation filtering and METAL/RE2C overlap handling are upstream stages; their settings do not establish the FUMA reference panel.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA and FAVOR for NPE variant-to-gene prioritization at P ≤ 1e-5 and within 10 kb of a protein-coding transcription start or end site. Ran MAGMA 1.10 gene and MSigDB GO/curated-set tests with gene threshold 2.5e-6 and per-NPE Bonferroni pathway correction.
review.implementation_scope_note: FUMA and FAVOR are jointly described, so do not assign every annotation to a specific backend. The literal 99.9% variant-PC variance/F-test description needs model reconciliation; it does not establish a raw-PC regression from P-only summary statistics. The FUMA release is unstated.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.5.2 on multivariate genomic SEM results to clump loci with a 1000 Genomes Phase 3 European reference and the reported r-squared > 0.6 and LD-block distance > 250 kb rules. Later combined FUMA/MAGMA gene associations mapped with 10 kb windows at P < 0.05/19154 with gsMAP expression correlations above 0.50.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the source inequalities without reversing their meaning. QSNP heterogeneity filtering is upstream. Open Targets/BigQuery novelty checks, bedtools overlaps and gsMAP/Cauchy cell-type analyses are separate. The result paragraph corroborates locus counts rather than supplying additional FUMA defaults.

supporting_evidence.section: Results / Capturing the shared genetic liability between MDD and disease clusters

review.use_summary: Used FUMA to integrate forearm-fracture lead variants and correlated variants at r-squared > 0.8 with ANNOVAR coding/splicing annotation and GTEx 8 cis-eQTLs. SNP2GENE-mapped genes were used for enrichment; follow-up also considered CADD 1.4 and RegulomeDB 1.1 annotations.
review.implementation_scope_note: The FUMA release is unstated. Osteoclast and osteoblast donor datasets and ChIP-Atlas bone ATAC evidence are separately described resources. PASCAL pathway testing is distinct; do not assign its KEGG/BIOCARTA/REACTOME tests or ATAC Q threshold to FUMA.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA to clump association results with lead P = 5e-8, candidate GWAS P = 0.05, LD thresholds r-squared 0.6 and 0.1 and the 1000 Genomes Phase 3 reference.
review.implementation_scope_note: The population subset, merge distance and FUMA release are unstated. Candidate GWAS P = 0.05 and lead P = 5e-8 serve different roles.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA GENE2FUNC for overrepresentation of GO cellular-component gene sets from MSigDB c5 and reported-trait genes from the GWAS Catalog.
review.implementation_scope_note: The background, correction method, significance cutoff, minimum overlap and FUMA release are unstated. The software-availability paragraph corroborates the named tool. Nearby MAGMA/ADMIXTURE versions must not be assigned to FUMA.

review.use_summary: Used FUMA 1.4.1 for two-step clumping with the literal P < 0.05/r-squared ≥ 0.6 and lead P < 5e-8/r-squared ≥ 0.1 rules, and positional/eQTL/chromatin mapping. Its MAGMA 1.08 SNP-wise-mean analysis used European 1000 Genomes Phase 3 LD and 17674 Ensembl 85 protein-coding genes with Bonferroni threshold 2.83e-6.
review.implementation_scope_note: GCTA-COJO 1.94.1 joint/conditional analysis follows FUMA and changes lead counts; distinguish 1650 leads/939 loci from 1307 COJO signals. Novelty comparisons, the August 2, 2023 GWAS Catalog snapshot, SMR/HEIDI replication and the independent Korean cohort analyses answer separate questions. The source is retained without relabeling the clumping inequalities.
